title: EvidenceLab public guide
text: EvidenceLab is a fictional research teaching platform. Public documents may be retrieved by every signed-in student. Every answer must point to a retrieved source passage.

title: Tenant zero operations
text: Tenant T-0 stores experiment reports for its own learners. Export retention is 14 days. Only the case owner or an administrator may inspect case history.

title: Tenant one operations
text: Tenant T-1 stores experiment reports for its own learners. Export retention is 21 days. Only the case owner or an administrator may inspect case history.

title: Superseded retention policy
text: This superseded fictional policy retained exports for 90 days. It is archived and must not override a newer tenant-specific policy.
